summary: The AI Resume Builder is a web application designed for a general audience, utilizing AI-powered technology to assist users in creating effective resumes. The application will be built using a microservices architecture and a tech stack that includes React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Express.js, and Docker. The application will also integrate with LinkedIn API for resume import and Google Drive API for resume storage.

The AI Powered Study Tracker is a web application designed for a general audience, utilizing AI-powered technology to assist users in tracking and managing their studies. The application will be built using a microservices architecture and a tech stack that includes React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, and will integrate with Google Calendar API, Google Drive API, and Microsoft Graph API.

The application will be built using a microservices architecture and a tech stack that includes React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, and will integrate with Stripe or PayPal for payment processing and Google Fit or Apple Health for fitness data integration.
